diet.title: Diet
diet.tip1: Get protein in every meal: egg, chicken, fish, dal or doi.
diet.tip2: Fill half your plate with vegetables, a bit less rice.
diet.tip3: Cut sugar, soft drinks and fried snacks as much as you can.
diet.tip4: Weigh yourself once a week, in the morning, before eating.
diet.how: Calculated with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula from your profile.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.intro: Ask anything about training, form, food or motivation. I know your profile and recent workouts.
coach.noKey1: Open aistudio.google.com and sign in with Google.
coach.noKey2: Click "Get API key" and create a key (free).
coach.noKey3: Paste it below. It is saved only in this browser.
coach.s1: My shoulder hurts on chest press, what should I check?
coach.s2: Make me a cheap high-protein Bangladeshi meal plan
coach.s3: How do I add weight safely each week?

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataNote: Everything is stored in this browser. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
settings.importError: That file is not a FitCoach backup.

schedule.days: Which days can you go to the gym?
schedule.daysHint: Pick 3 to 6 days. Tap a day to turn it on or off.
schedule.restText: No gym today. Rest helps your muscles grow. A 30 minute walk is a good idea.
schedule.doneText: Great work. Eat enough protein and sleep 7–8 hours.
schedule.recommend: Best day to make it up: {{day}}
schedule.why: It's a free day and it isn't next to another {{w}}, so your muscles get time to recover.
schedule.recommendToday: Today is free, so today is the best day to make it up.
schedule.noDay: No free day left this week. Do it now if you have energy, or skip it. Next week starts fresh.
schedule.tapHint: Busy on a gym day? Tap that day above to move the workout.
schedule.shiftTitle: No free day left, so shift your week
schedule.shiftText: Do {{w}} on {{day}} and push the rest of the week back by one day. {{last}} on {{lastDay}} will be skipped.
schedule.moreMissed: {{n}} more missed this week. It will show up after you decide on this one.
